mapper.select: SELECT * FROM followup_topics WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM followup_topics WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id FROM conversations c WHERE c.id=(SELECT t.source_conversation_id FROM followup_topics t WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.user_id=#{userId}) AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.* FROM followup_topics t JOIN conversations c ON c.id=t.source_conversation_id AND c.user_id=t.user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.state IN ('authorized','paused') ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM followup_topics WHERE state='authorized' AND next_eligible_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_eligible_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE followup_topics SET reason=#{reason}, state=#{state}, next_eligible_at=#{nextEligibleAt}, unanswered_count=#{unansweredCount}, last_delivered_at=#{lastDeliveredAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND state='authorized'
UPDATE followup_topics SET state='deleted', updated_at=#{at} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND state <> 'deleted'
UPDATE followup_topics SET state='paused', unanswered_count=0, updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND (state='authorized' OR (state='paused' AND unanswered_count >= 2))

UPDATE followup_topics t JOIN conversations c ON c.id=t.source_conversation_id AND c.user_id=t.user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL SET t.state='authorized', t.unanswered_count=0, t.next_eligible_at=GREATEST(COALESCE(t.next_eligible_at, #{eligibleAt}), #{eligibleAt}, COALESCE(DATE_ADD(t.last_delivered_at, INTERVAL 7 DAY), #{eligibleAt})), t.updated_at=#{at} WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.state='paused'

UPDATE followup_topics t JOIN conversations c ON c.id=t.source_conversation_id AND c.user_id=t.user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL SET t.state='authorized', t.unanswered_count=0, t.next_eligible_at=GREATEST(#{eligibleAt}, COALESCE(DATE_ADD(t.last_delivered_at, INTERVAL 7 DAY), #{eligibleAt})), t.updated_at=#{at} WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.state='paused' AND t.unanswered_count >= 2
UPDATE followup_topics SET unanswered_count=0, updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND state='authorized'
UPDATE inbox_items SET state='dismissed' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_kind='followup_topic' AND source_id=#{topicId} AND state IN ('unread','read','snoozed')

UPDATE inbox_items SET body='来源对话已删除', state='dismissed' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_kind='followup_topic' AND source_id IN (SELECT id FROM followup_topics WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_conversation_id=#{conversationId})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_preferences (user_id,timezone,max_per_day,max_per_week,enabled,updated_at) VALUES (#{userId},'Asia/Shanghai',1,3,1,#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM followup_preferences WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox_items WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND kind='followup' AND scheduled_at >= #{since} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox_items (id,user_id,kind,source_kind,source_id,body,scheduled_at,state,created_at,read_at,snoozed_until) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{kind},#{sourceKind},#{sourceId},#{body},#{scheduledAt},#{state},#{createdAt},#{readAt},#{snoozedUntil}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inbox_items WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_kind='followup_topic' AND source_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM inbox_items WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM inbox_items WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM inbox_items WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND state <> 'dismissed' ORDER BY CASE WHEN state='unread' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, scheduled_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox_items WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND state='unread'
mapper.update: UPDATE inbox_items SET state='unread', snoozed_until=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND state='snoozed' AND snoozed_until <= #{now}

UPDATE inbox_items SET state=#{state},read_at=#{readAt},snoozed_until=#{snoozedUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND state IN ('unread','read','snoozed') AND NOT (#{state}='read' AND state='read')
